It replaces the older steady-column representation for this model purpose, but does not override B6N8-H/I readiness or qualify a runtime/provider.

recipes.continental: Retain authored q_s, TSurf, cellwise crust thickness and authored total thickness H. Use existing reference-layer properties and source term. Solve the existing effective Tdot closure for T_LAB=T_ad(H); derive continuous Moho profile. Tdot is an instantaneous closure, expressly not a temporal-history primitive.
recipes.positive_age_ocean: Evaluate existing HWR-2 T(z,t), q(z,t) using governed positive oceanic lithosphere age, then use the existing Hermite layer projection and thermal/adiabatic crossing rule.
recipes.age_zero_ridge: Never evaluate HWR at age zero. Use the source-defined effective-age inversion of the authored ridge heat-flow boundary; this derived index is not geological age.

temporal.pre_T0_explicit_integration: Not needed to evaluate the selected formula if its T0 inputs are authorized; this does not prove prior physical history unnecessary.
temporal.post_event_thermal_transition: No instantaneous thermal discontinuity is authorized by B6N1 activation alone; T1 PRE_EVENT thermal payload may be reused for T1 POST_EVENT only if no separately authorized instantaneous thermal transition exists.
